title: Experience of traveling to Da Nang on April 30 for first-time travelers

html:
The April 30-May 1 holiday is one of the longest holidays of the year, although not as long as the Tet holiday, but much longer than the summer holiday or other holidays of the year, many of you will choose the holiday time to travel, relax after a stressful working period, and Da Nang is the most ideal destination for you during this holiday, please refer to the experience of traveling to Da Nang on April 30 for first-time travelers below.

Note before traveling to Da Nang on April 30

  • If you travel to Da Nang on your own, the first thing you should do is book plane, train, or car tickets to avoid the situation where you book close to the date and the ticket price will increase, you should choose and consider to get the most reasonable price.
  • Book a hotel room: Usually close to the holiday, the ticket price increases or there are often no rooms available. So you should proactively book a room early to avoid the situation of no rooms available or not getting a room with the desired sea view.
  • Plan your trip with your friends, from dining spots, entertainment areas, or the most suitable camping sites.
  • What to bring when going on a tour to Da Nang: The weather in Da Nang in April is hot and sunny in the summer and there are occasional sudden showers, so you need to bring an umbrella, and don’t forget your swimsuit or dress to take beautiful pictures.
  • Bring cash so you can enjoy Da Nang street food, or buy souvenirs as gifts.

Da Nang Climate April 30

April Da Nang weather in the summer starts to get hotter from April to August, which is the ideal time for tourists to visit and explore the famous sights of Da Nang, the temperature at this time will fluctuate between 24 and 33 degrees Celsius, this is the ideal time for you to visit Da Nang.

Means of transportation to visit Da Nang during the April 30 – May 1 holiday, you should choose the following means:

  • Motorbike: Da Nang is very crowded during the holidays, so many tourists often choose to rent a motorbike in Da Nang to visit the famous sights very conveniently.
  • Taxi rental: On holidays, renting a taxi will cost a little more than usual, but the driver will show you the way to the famous sights faster.
  • Self-driving car rental: For those who are familiar with the roads of Da Nang, you can rent a car by the day. However, all of this is only for those who travel to Da Nang on their own. On the contrary, if you go on a Da Nang tour with a travel agency, there will be a full package in the tour itinerary, you just need to pack your backpack and go sightseeing.

What to do when traveling to Da Nang

Da Nang on April 30-May 1 is the summer season with blue sea, white sand, and golden sunshine, and is also home to many famous landmarks, especially poetic beaches such as: Lang Van Beach, Non Nuoc, My Khe, Bac My An… In addition, you can also participate in many recreational activities such as: Diving to see coral, surfing, fishing, jet skiing…

Sightseeing spots in Da Nang that you cannot miss when going on a Da Nang tour on April 30-May 1

  • Cham Museum: Where Cham cultural artifacts are still displayed.
  • Da Nang Museum: Where the city’s cultural history is displayed.
  • Asia Park: Coming here, you will be able to visit exciting games that will bring you the most exciting feeling.
  • Ba Na Hills: Where many exciting festivals and events take place, right on top of Ba Na.

Besides the bustling scenery of Da Nang City, there are also peaceful countrysides, which are also destinations chosen by many tourists such as: Tra Que vegetable village, Hoa Phong flower village, Kim Bong carpentry village … coming here, you will feel the peaceful scenery and experience the daily life of the people here.

The sacred pagodas in Da Nang must include Linh Ung Pagoda, Da Nang has 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, with a majestic statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara overlooking the East Sea.

In addition, when traveling Da Nang from April 30 to May 1, you can also visit places near Da Nang such as Hue, Hoi An, or experience taking a canoe to Cu Lao Cham island to soak in the cool water, or conquer the Hai Van pass, you can freely take virtual photos on the windy pass.

With the experience of traveling to Da Nang from April 30 to May 1 that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your trip, wishing you a happy holiday.
